entries.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
entries.snippet: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.

entries.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
entries.snippet: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.

entries.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico to file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
entries.snippet: The US media outlets say they are defending "the principle that the government does not decide what the press reports or publishes".

entries.title: Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance
entries.snippet: The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.

entries.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
entries.snippet: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

entries.title: British Museum bans visitors from photographing Bayeux Tapestry
entries.snippet: Visitors stopping to take pictures of the 68m medieval embroidery were holding up others, prompting the rule change.

entries.title: Three arrested in South Africa over one of nine women's body finds
entries.snippet: The body of Jabulile Ntimba was the ninth to be found recently in an area east of Johannesburg.

entries.title: Jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia, BBC finds
entries.snippet: Undercover footage recorded by the BBC reveals he has been released after serving less than half his sentence.

entries.title: US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit
entries.snippet: Top US and Chinese officials held talks in New York on Sunday ahead of a Trump-Xi summit this week.

entries.title: UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC
entries.snippet: It comes after European Commission President proposed "opening the door" for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.

entries.title: Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford's son, dies aged 27
entries.snippet: His family asked for privacy during a "very difficult and painful time" following the model's death.

entries.title: Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband says he forgave her so he would not be 'eaten up inside forever'
entries.snippet: Patrick Clancy gives his first interview since his wife's mistrial over the killing of their three young children.

entries.title: Sydney policeman allegedly disguised himself as Uber Eats rider before murders
entries.snippet: Beaumont Lamarre-Condon has pleaded not guilty to the 2024 murder of his ex-partner and his new boyfriend.

entries.title: Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting
entries.snippet: While Burnham praised the agreement, Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it a "pretend" victory for Trump.

entries.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
entries.snippet: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

entries.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
entries.snippet: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

entries.title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
entries.snippet: Aleema Khanum is accused of mobilising her brother’s supporters ahead of country-wide protests.

entries.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
entries.snippet: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

entries.title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
entries.snippet: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

entries.title: Workers came across human remains – and unearthed a mass grave of 572 people
entries.snippet: Workers in northern Sri Lanka accidentally uncovered the country's largest mass grave – and reopened wounds from its civil war.

entries.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
entries.snippet: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

entries.title: German chancellor stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
entries.snippet: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

entries.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
entries.snippet: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

entries.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
entries.snippet: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

entries.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
entries.snippet: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

entries.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
entries.snippet: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

entries.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
entries.snippet: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.

entries.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico will sue Trump after being barred from White House
entries.snippet: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

entries.title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
entries.snippet: The Department of Homeland Security said Monday it was leading the investigation into the officer involved in a shooting of "an illegal alien from Venezuela" during an operation in Austin, Texas.

entries.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
entries.snippet: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

entries.title: World leaders meet at UN as planet grapples with war, runaway AI and climate shocks
entries.snippet: Under a global cloud of bitter divisions, world leaders meet at the United Nations this week facing new fears.

entries.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico say they've notified Trump they're suing over denied White House access
entries.snippet: The actions were a clear escalation of President Donald Trump's long-running efforts — in the courts and through administrative action — to restrict news coverage by journalists he finds objectionable, and were the latest test of First Amendment protections in the United States.

entries.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas, officials say
entries.snippet: The unnamed man was in serious but stable condition at a hospital after being shot once in the torso on the city's north side, Austin Police Chief Lisa Davis said at a news conference.

entries.title: Carney and Macron deepen ties as Canada turns toward Europe and away from U.S. dependence
entries.snippet: Carney said the countries will task their space agencies and defense ministries to develop and share infrastructure, including launch systems and ground-based reception facilities. They also agreed to expand cooperation in energy, telecommunications, climate resilience and econom

entries.title: Converse apologizes and pulls sneaker ad that critics said included racist imagery
entries.snippet: Critics lashed out online, saying that a white triangular image created by lighting on K-pop singer Karina's skirt resembled a KKK hood and that the way she held the sneakers made them look like the dangling feet of a lynching victim.

entries.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited from Haiti to U.S.
entries.snippet: The suspects who remain in Haiti awaiting trial included more than a dozen Colombian soldiers, a former Haitian police officer and Joseph Badio, a former Haiti Ministry of Justice employee who was part of an anti-corruption unit.

entries.title: Russia wraps up first wartime parliamentary election with Kremlin dominance all but assured
entries.snippet: The vote included residents of four Ukrainian regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the war began but still doesn't fully control, as well as those in Crimea, the Black Sea peninsula that was illegally annexed by Russia in 2014.

entries.title: Iran-backed Houthi rebels warn against joining Saudi Arabia in Yemen's growing civil war
entries.snippet: Mohamed al-Bukhaiti, a member of the Houthis' political bureau, said Washington reached out to the rebels after their rapid advance down Yemen's western coast to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait earlier this month.

entries.title: Alaskans will decide fate of ranked choice voting system after chaotic end to state's primary
entries.snippet: The August primary revealed some of the headaches related to a major change in how Alaska voters select their candidates and was the latest example of how the real-world experience of state voting changes don't always line up neatly with expectations.

entries.title: Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after party's historic defeat in 2 German state elections
entries.snippet: Should the Christian Democratic Union stay below 5% in the final vote count, it would mean that the party would fail for the first time to win seats in a state legislature anywhere in Germany.

entries.title: Federal Reserve rate hike reflects new world of sticky inflation and faster growth
entries.snippet: The low interest-rate, low-inflation world that lasted for nearly 15 years after the Great Recession is over and a higher-priced, higher-rate world is taking its place.

entries.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including 'largest ever' attack on Moscow
entries.snippet: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" drone attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to the Moscow Oil Refinery and a residential building.

entries.title: North Korea launches 2 ballistic missiles toward the sea and dials up pressure on the U.S.
entries.snippet: The launches were the latest in a series of weapons demonstrations by North Korea even after President Donald Trump scaled back a joint military exercise with South Korea last month in an apparent effort to revive diplomacy with the North's leader, Kim Jong Un.

entries.title: Ed Sheeran says situation in Gaza is 'catastrophic and unjustifiable' as he opens concert
entries.snippet: Sheeran said he wants his music and shows to be about unity and humanity, not politics. But he said the attacks in Israel of Oct. 7, 2023, were horrific and what is happening in Gaza "catastrophic and unjustifiable."

entries.title: Trump says his planned arch would become a 'military complex' able to host drones and snipers
entries.snippet: Trump has also been calling the new White House ballroom a "military complex" and arguing it is necessary for national security purposes.

entries.title: For Palestinian aid groups, Macklemore's $1M pledge brings relief and attention to ongoing suffering
entries.snippet: Macklemore committed to donate his net earnings from Ed Sheeran's Loop Tour after he was dropped for making pro-Palestinian comments onstage at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia confirms Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack its capital with a ballistic missile
entries.snippet: The growing conflict near another important global shipping corridor has brought new pressures for markets.

entries.title: Michigan city defends itself against accusations of favoring Muslim holidays over other faiths
entries.snippet: A statement from the Detroit suburb issued by a spokesperson came in response to a lawsuit on Thursday that accused the city and its mayor of spending thousands of dollars to celebrate Muslim holidays while ignoring Christian and Jewish holidays.

entries.title: Congo begins Ebola vaccinations for health workers in the epicenter of the outbreak
entries.snippet: Health workers and other front-line workers in the Ebola response are being prioritized to receive the Ervebo vaccine that was effective in past Ebola outbreaks caused by a different, more common type of virus.

entries.title: Russian election observer loses consciousness during arrest by police, opposition party says
entries.snippet: The three-day election, which began Friday and ends Sunday, features virtually no opposition and is all but certain to secure the Kremlin's political dominance.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Germany news: Trial starts of ex-Transport Minister Scheuer
entries.snippet: Former Transport Minister Andreas Scheuer is being tried for perjury related to a failed car toll scheme. And cherry farmers have brought in a bumper harvest. DW has more.

entries.title: Taliban says three killed in new Pakistan airstrikes on Afghanistan
entries.snippet: The Afghan border provinces of Kunar and Paktika were reportedly struck. Pakistan last carried out deadly strikes on Afghanistan in June.

entries.title: Germany's car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
entries.snippet: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers' rights.

entries.title: US proposes AI safety mechanism in talks with China
entries.snippet: US Treasury chief Scott Bessent said there had been "successful" talks with China on trade and AI. The talks come amid growing fears that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.

entries.title: India news: India's medal tally at Asian games rises to six
entries.snippet: Indian athletes won two bronze and two silver medals on the second day of the Asian Games in Japan. Meanwhile, more bodies were recovered after a flash flood in Kerala. DW has more.

entries.title: Japan: Typhoon Dujuan sparks flood, landslide warnings
entries.snippet: Evacuation advisories have been issued and hundreds of flights have been canceled in Japan, which is in the middle of a five-day holiday. The storm could dump record levels of rain on the country.

entries.title: US: Man wounded in Texas after being shot by ICE agent
entries.snippet: An ICE agent shot and wounded a man in Austin, Texas. The city's mayor has called for an independent investigation into the shooting.

entries.title: Iran closes language center in Tehran, France vows response
entries.snippet: In response to the Iranian authorities' decision to close a French language center affiliated with its embassy in Tehran, France vowed to take appropriate measures.

entries.title: Canada, France agree to closer ties in defense, economy
entries.snippet: Amid strained relations with the US, French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced closer economic and defense ties.

entries.title: German state elections deal a blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz
entries.snippet: Elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania have dealt the CDU a historic defeat while the AfD saw a massive gain. The pressure on Germany's unpopular chancellor is mounting.

entries.title: AfD makes gains in state elections but has no government options
entries.snippet: Despite making significant gains in both Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the far-right AfD remains without options to form a state government.

entries.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
entries.snippet: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.

entries.title: Peter Thiel: Power, Palantir, and the antichrist
entries.snippet: He was early to back Facebook, early to back Donald Trump, and is one of the world’s richest people. But from his theories on the antichrist and AI to his distinctive politics, Peter Thiel is hard to pin down.

entries.title: Russia: Ukrainian drone strike on Moscow kills 2
entries.snippet: An oil refinery was hit in one of the largest attacks so far on the Russian capital, as the country holds a parliamentary election. Meanwhile, at least four people were killed in Russian strikes in Ukraine's Kyiv region.

entries.title: Ed Sheeran speaks on Gaza in concert after Macklemore controversy
entries.snippet: Sheeran called the Hamas-led attack in Israel "horrific" and described the war in Gaza as "catastrophic and unjustifiable" during his first concert since the Macklemore controversy erupted.

entries.title: In cosmopolitan Berlin, elections still closed to foreigners
entries.snippet: A quarter of Berlin residents will have no say in the German capital's city-state election because they lack citizenship. That's the highest proportion of residents excluded from the election yet, and many are unhappy.

entries.title: India news: PM Modi says developing nations unfairly blamed for emissions
entries.snippet: PM Narendra Modi has told a climate conference that developed countries emit six times more CO2 than India. Meanwhile, an IIT Bombay professor has been accused of caste abuse. DW has more.

entries.title: Germany news: Doctors offer Oktoberfest flu jabs
entries.snippet: Oktoberfest 2026 is underway but it's not just beer on offer in Munich this year; revelers can also get themselves a flu jab before heading to the tents. DW has more.

entries.title: Decolonizing perceptions about Africa
entries.snippet: As a UN resolution alters the standard global map to reflect the continent more accurately, initiatives to decolonize African schools and a campaign to present positive developments are changing the way Africa is seen.
